description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Point and line representations locate capital projects from transportation, airport/ferry, surface-water and sewer improvement plans, with shared Project_ID and estimated construction-year fields. The native layers expose point, polyline geometry and named attributes, including Project_ID, Name, Description, Estimated_Construction_Year, Division, Contact. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for capacity planning studies. Both geometry layers form one project resource. Scope, schedule and location can change; routine chipseal, paving and guardrail programmes are excluded. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
